use_case_summary: Primary workload: high-volume short-form content generation (social, emails, landing pages). Batch generation is common (jobs of 10k+ prompts nightly). Latency target: <250ms median for small prompt responses; throughput target: sustained 400-700 reqs/sec during peak batch windows. Cost sensitivity: high — target is to reduce per-1k-token spend by 40% vs current vendor. Prefer hosted API for self-serve simplicity; interested in prefix/KV caching and continuous batching to lower unit costs.
